image: Water comes again and again: Pit after pit.
lines: down into a pit inside the pit.
Down into the pit inside the pit.
A jar of wine, two vessels of grain —
the simple gift passed in at the window.

notes.name_en: 坎 is a pit, hole, trap in the ground (its trigram image is water collected in it). Title keeps the trap-thing, rejecting Wilhelm's 'Abysmal' and a generic 'Water'.
notes.judgment: 習坎有孚維心亨行有尚。 習 holds both 'repeated' (trigram doubled) and 'practised at'; verse takes repetition ('pit after pit'), and the practised sense answers back in the Image （習教事 'practises teaching'). 尚 = honoured/valued, kept as esteem, not success. 心亨 per glossary: the heart goes through.
notes.image: 水洊至習坎；君子以常德行習教事。 洊 = arriving again, rendered 'comes again and again'. The 習 pivot (repeated pit / repeated practice) is preserved by echo, not explained.
notes.L2: 九二 坎有險求小得。 Read as outcome — seeking yields a little — rather than advice to ask small; 'Seeking brings a little' stays open to both without adding 'only'.
notes.L3: 六三 來之坎坎險且枕入于坎窞勿用。 之 read as 'going' against 來 'coming'. 枕 read literally as pillow/resting on peril (a traditional reading: lying on danger); alternatives gloss 枕 as 'deep'. Literal pillow kept and flagged here.
notes.L4: 六四 樽酒簋貳用缶納約自牖終無咎。 簋 are ritual grain vessels — 'vessels of grain' is an approximation. 約 = the simple/frugal (thing offered), rendered 'simple gift'; 牖 is a window-opening where light enters. Plainness, not ritual theory, carries the line.
notes.L5: 九五 坎不盈祗既平無咎。 盈 = full to brimming; 祗 = only/just. Water level, not yet overflowing — the point at which it can level out.
notes.L6: 上六 係用徽纆寘于叢棘三歲不得凶。 徽纆 are binding cords; 叢棘 a thorn enclosure (a prison). 不得 has no object in the Chinese; 'no way out' supplies release as the missing object.
